description: Payment stack self-test at 0.01 USDC. A bare GET that answers the 402 challenge, settles 0.01 USDC on Base through x402, and returns a JSON receipt proving the caller's payment path works end to end: result, atomic amount, network, payment hash, and settle timestamp. Input: none. Output: one receipt. Price: $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.
name: pay-test-0-01
